properties.name: cosid.machine.distributor.provider
properties.description: Removed in 4.0: set cosid.machine.distributor.type to the type of an application's CosIdStoreProvider (its getType()) instead.

deprecation.reason: The store type also selects an application's CosIdStoreProvider by its getType().

properties.name: cosid.segment.distributor.provider
properties.description: Removed in 4.0: set cosid.segment.distributor.type to the type of an application's CosIdStoreProvider (its getType()) instead.

deprecation.reason: The store type also selects an application's CosIdStoreProvider by its getType().

properties.name: cosid.jdbc.enabled
properties.description: Whether the Spring Data JDBC integration fills @Id properties and @CosId fields of entities. Off by default since 4.0: Spring Data JDBC users must set it to true.

properties.name: cosid.actuator.delete.enabled
properties.description: Whether the cosid actuator endpoint has its DELETE operation, which removes an id generator at runtime. Off by default since 4.0: the endpoint is read-only.

properties.name: cosid.mybatis.enabled
properties.description: Whether the MyBatis plugin fills id fields.

properties.name: cosid.flowable.enabled
properties.description: Whether CosId provides the Flowable id generator.

properties.name: cosid.activiti.enabled
properties.description: Whether CosId provides the Activiti id generator.
